name: droplet_cool_flame
title: Droplet model: cool-flame evidence after visible extinction
target_label: report caption states evidence of cool-flame burning after the visible flame went out

dropped_features.flow_cm_s: every FLEX droplet burned in still gas: the feature is constant
dropped_features.flow_direction: not applicable to a droplet in still gas
dropped_features.gravity_g: the data span one gravity level (microgravity); the specification says to drop it
dropped_features.material_class: every labelled row is n-heptane: the feature is constant

added_features.co2_pct: CO2 dilution is the suppression variable FLEX was flown to test; leaving it out would hide the experiment's main factor
added_features.he_pct: helium dilution is FLEX's second suppression variable (51 tests)

notes: Labels come from the FLEX report's figure captions (authors' inference from vaporisation and vapour cloud), and exist for n-heptane only.
Rows: n-heptane tests that ended in Extinction and whose caption says 'evidence' or 'no evidence'. Unclear and silent captions are left out, not counted as negatives.
Very small and unbalanced. Exploratory only.
